context: Asuka discusses creativity and perspective with Sakura.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: writing lecture; vocabulary (創造/見方/驚き/真剣/扱う) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 創造には、新しい見方が要ります。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 見方を変えると、どうなりますか?
lines.en: What happens when you change your perspective?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 日常が、驚きに満ちて見えます。
lines.en: The everyday appears full of wonder.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 創造を、真剣に学びたいです。
lines.en: I want to seriously study creation.
lines.style: earnest adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 真剣に向き合えば、扱う題材も深まります。
lines.en: If you engage seriously, your subjects deepen too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 難しい題材も、扱えますか?
lines.en: Can I handle difficult subjects too?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 見方次第で、何でも扱えますよ。
lines.en: Depending on perspective, you can handle anything.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 小さな驚きを、大切にします。
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
